name: Hip Extension Isolation
definition: A strict unilateral open-chain isolation movement in which the femur extends relative to a position-held pelvis while the spine and knee postures remain held. The roster owns a prone-table bent-knee fixture, a supported low-pulley ankle-cuff fixture, and the Technogym Selection Glute machine triangulated from Stien's Selection kickback trial and the matching manufacturer manual. The study moves from approximately 90 degrees of hip flexion to neutral with the knee held near 170 degrees; the manual pins the pad, platform, roller, handgrip, and selectorized cable-lever topology. Pelvis and spine position-held semantics narrow the manual's instructed pad contact and are not measured kinematics. Gluteus maximus is primary and medial hamstrings are secondary by anatomy-mechanics inference. Stien measured a biceps-femoris site, while the app combines long and short heads in one visible mesh; that combined app region remains stabilizer-only. Bridges, hip thrusts, hinges, quadruped kickbacks, other machines, bands, unsupported cable variants, and movements driven by the pelvis or spine remain outside this contract.

exerciseRules.description: The prone fixture preserves its exact table support, 30-to-5-degree range, and 90-degree knee posture.
The reviewed cable fixture starts from neutral, uses a low pulley and cuff above the ankle, braces both hands at waist height, and preserves the reported 15-to-20-degree endpoint interval.
The machine branch is only the studied unilateral Technogym Selection Glute fixture and preserves its supported 90-degree-to-neutral range and near-extended knee.

execution.startingPosition: Lie face down with your torso and pelvis supported on a table and your working thigh hanging beyond its edge. Begin with your thigh angled 30 degrees downward.
execution.movement: Lift the thigh until it reaches 5 degrees behind your body.
execution.endpoint: End the lift with the thigh 5 degrees behind your body.
execution.returnPhase: Lower your thigh under control without changing the knee angle or moving through your back or pelvis.
execution.controlledJoints: Keep your working knee bent at 90 degrees, and keep your pelvis and back still.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep your torso and pelvis supported on the table throughout the set.
disqualifyingCompensations: Straightening the working knee during the lift turns the bent-knee hip extension into a straight-leg raise.
Rocking the pelvis or arching the back turns the isolated hip extension into a spine-driven back extension.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete all repetitions on one side, then repeat with the other leg.

execution.startingPosition: Attach an ankle cuff just above the working ankle to the low pulley, face the machine, and brace both hands on its pressing arm at waist height. Stand tall with a slight bend in the working knee. Log the entered stack load and compare it only on this same fixture and setup.
execution.movement: Keep the pelvis and spine still while extending the working thigh straight behind the body.
execution.endpoint: Stop with the working leg 15 to 20 degrees behind the body; the source reports this interval rather than one exact endpoint.
execution.returnPhase: Bring the thigh forward under control to the neutral start without letting the stack pull the pelvis forward.
execution.controlledJoints: Hold the slight knee bend and keep the toes and kneecap facing forward.
execution.supportAndPosture: Use both hands for support while keeping the standing leg and trunk still.
disqualifyingCompensations: Arching the back or rotating the pelvis changes the isolated hip action.
Bending and straightening the working knee adds a knee-driven movement.
Moving the cuff away from just above the ankle changes the reviewed resistance geometry.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete all repetitions on one side, then repeat with the other leg.

execution.startingPosition: Compare the entered load only on this Technogym Selection Glute fixture. Face the machine, keep the abdomen and hips against the pad, hold the handgrips, plant the support foot on the platform, and place the working leg in front of the roller with the hip near 90 degrees of flexion and the knee slightly bent.
execution.movement: Drive the working thigh backward through the lever path while holding the pelvis, spine, and knee positions.
execution.endpoint: Stop when the working hip reaches approximately neutral.
execution.returnPhase: Allow the lever to bring the thigh forward under control to the approximately 90-degree hip-flexion start.
execution.controlledJoints: Create the repetition by moving the thigh backward while keeping the knee slightly bent and still and the hips against the pad.
execution.supportAndPosture: Keep the support foot planted, the abdomen and hips against the pad, and both hands on the machine.
disqualifyingCompensations: Arching or rotating the trunk changes the isolated hip action.
Bending and straightening the working knee adds a knee-driven movement.
Using another machine model or resistance interface changes the fixture-specific load history.
execution.sideOrDirection: Complete all repetitions on one side, then repeat with the other leg.
